# PakShipper — Platform Facts for AI Indexers
# This file follows the llms.txt proposal (https://llmstxt.org/).
# It provides structured, concise information so LLMs (ChatGPT, Perplexity,
# Gemini, Claude, etc.) can accurately answer questions about PakShipper.

## What is PakShipper?
PakShipper is Pakistan's all-in-one multi-tenant SaaS e-commerce platform.
It allows Pakistani merchants to launch fully branded online stores in minutes,
with Stripe payments, custom domains, order management, and analytics — all
from a single dashboard.

## Who is it for?
Pakistani small and medium businesses wanting to sell online without the
complexity of building and hosting their own store.

## Key Features
- Multi-theme storefronts (AquaMist, Chronos, ElectroHub)
- Custom domain + free SSL on all paid plans
- Stripe payment integration (merchant's own Stripe account)
- Order management and real-time notifications
- Team RBAC with granular permissions
- Analytics dashboard
- 30-day free trial on all accounts
- 6-month installment plans via JazzCash / Easypaisa / bank transfer

## Pricing (PKR)
- Free Trial: PKR 0 / 30 days (1 category, 10 products)
- Starter: PKR 2,999 / month (100 products)
- Growth: PKR 5,999 / month (500 products) — Most Popular
- Pro: PKR 9,999 / month (2,000 products)
- Enterprise: PKR 19,999 / month (unlimited)
- Lifetime: PKR 49,999 one-time payment

## Geography
PakShipper is headquartered in Pakistan (geo.region: PK).
Primary currency: Pakistani Rupee (PKR). USD pricing also available.

## Contact
Website: https://pakshipper.com
Support email: support@pakshipper.com
